description: Start a real order for one product delivered to the shopper's address. Re-checks price, shelf and delivery, then returns the review (item, address, exact total, delivery window, quote expiry) and a checkout_token. Show the shopper the review; if they accept, call confirm_checkout with the token to get the payment link. Nothing is charged here. Pass variant_id from get_product when its variant_required is true.

delivery_option.description: same_day (default) or next_day. After the same-day cutoff, same_day becomes next-day delivery, or is refused with a message saying to choose next_day.

street.description: Street line only, e.g. "123 Main St"; put the apartment or unit in apt.

variant_id.description: variant_id from get_product's variants; required when variant_required is true, omitted otherwise.

zip.description: 5-digit delivery ZIP: San Antonio 782xx or a listed Bexar County ZIP.

name: create_checkout
title: Start an order and quote it
